title: WA HASRATA HUSSAINA
body:
Zan haay Shaam o Kufa Wa Hasrata Hussaina
Benindaye Tamasha Wa Hasrata Hussaina
Zainab Aseere aada Wa Hasrata Hussaina
<<MINI>>
Sadd Al Wida Hussaina Wa Hasrata Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
Zakhmi shuda Khudaya Wa Hasrata Hussaina
Az Taaziaana har jaa Wa Hasrata Hussaina
Pehluwe Binte Zehra Wa Hasrata Hussaina
<<MINI>>
Sadd Al Wida Hussaina Wa Hasrata Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
Goyed Zehra Hazeena Wa Hasrata Hussaina
Veerana Shud Madina Wa Hasrata Hussaina
<<MINI>>
Shud Be Pidar Sakina Wa Hasrata Hussaina
Sadd Al Wida Hussaina Wa Hasrata Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
Az Margat ain asr shud Wa Hasrata Hussaina
Rang e jaha'n deegar shud Wa Hasrata Hussaina
Zainab barehna sar shud Wa Hasrata Hussaina
<<MINI>>
Sadd Al Wida Hussaina Wa Hasrata Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
Goyed Sakina pur Gham Wa Hasrata Hussaina
Az dast e shimr e Azlam Wa Hasrata Hussaina
Khu'n shud rawan zee gosHam Wa Hasrata Hussaina
<<MINI>>
Sadd Al Wida Hussaina Wa Hasrata Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
Bastande qaum e ada Wa Hasrata Hussaina
Dar ek rasan ba eeza Wa Hasrata Hussaina
Aale Rasool e khud Ra Wa Hasrata Hussaina
<<MINI>>
Sadd Al Wida Hussaina Wa Hasrata Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
Kursi nasheen sitamgar Wa Hasrata Hussaina
Dar tashte farq e Athar Wa Hasrata Hussaina
Dar e zindaan sitamgar Wa Hasrata Hussaina
<<MINI>>
Sadd Al Wida Hussaina Wa Hasrata Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
*
author: Aulad Hussain Lallan
